headline: WhiteFiber Acquires Two North Carolina Data Center Development Sites
summary: AI infrastructure provider WhiteFiber announced that its subsidiary Enovum Data Centers Corp. completed the acquisition of two data center development sites in North Carolina.
why: Data centers are critical physical infrastructure for scaling artificial intelligence workloads and cloud computing services, serving as key capital expenditure items for tech infrastructure providers.

impacts.name: WhiteFiber, Inc.
impacts.why: WhiteFiber is the primary company executing the data center site acquisitions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
